<b>Conchcutter</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It throws a ricocheting, drilling projectile similar to those of the [[Driznit]], [[Driznarga]], and [[Great Conchflies]].

== Usefulness ==
Conchcutter is thrown diagnally downwards in the direction [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] is facing and will ricochet off walls in an ordinal direction. When colliding with an [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemy]] it will slow its movement and rapidly drill into them, dealing damage up to six times before breaking.  

Its multi-hit and ricocheting properties makes it most effective in tight spaces and/or in the presence of a lot of enemies.

== How to Acquire ==
Found inside [[Coral Tower]] in the west of [[Sands of Karak]], accessible after defeating the [[Raging Conchfly]].
